content:
Aisha (Product): Quick design review: proposal for a reduced-density network step in Private wizard. Show one compact row per probe (status chip + short hint) and hide raw logs behind an explicit 'Show full probe output' control.

Ravi (Frontend): Works for mobile. Dev note: make the expander animate and keep logs in a <pre> with a copy button. Cap height to 380px to avoid global scroll hijack.

Kofi (Accessibility): Must expose aria-expanded, use aria-live for probe completion, and not rely on color alone for status. Provide icon + text on chips. Chevrons need descriptive labels.

Marcus (DevEx): When a probe fails, surface a tiny 'Try these fixes' list with 2-3 actions and a Retry button. KB links open in new tab and we track clicks.

Marta (PM): Capture metrics: probe duration, final status, expanded detail clicks, retry clicks, KB clicks.

Aisha (Product): I'll update the mock to: left chip (icon+text), center hint, right chevron 'Show full probe output (includes timestamp & command)'. Move timestamp/command into expanded view.

CI Bot: deploy queued for branch ux/compact-connectivity-lite by aisha — CI green :white_check_mark:
_note: Messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names per agents.md
